recap.back_html: Situation: when and where. Behaviour: what a camera would record. Impact: the effect, as an "I" statement.
Ask what the person was trying to do. It turns feedback into a conversation and often changes your view.
Listen to the end, ask for an example, thank them, decide what to change, and tell them later.
Ask a narrow question about one area, not "any feedback?".

lessons.takeaway_html: Give feedback as situation, behaviour and impact. Describe what a camera would see, state the effect as an "I" statement, and ask about intent. Use it for praise as well as for change.
lessons.title: Give and receive feedback with situation, behaviour and impact

recap.back_html: Start-up, turnaround, accelerated growth, realignment and sustaining success.
Situation, expectations, resources, style and personal development.
Small, visible results tied to your manager's priorities, agreed in advance.
Arriving with the answer: changing things before you learn how they work and who depends on them.

lessons.takeaway_html: Diagnose your STARS situation, hold the five conversations with your manager early, learn before you change, secure small agreed wins, and log them as you go.
lessons.title: Your first 90 days in a new role
